content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Fayetteville

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires specific education and project-management experience before you apply. Review PMI's dual-track requirements—your combination of degree level and months managing projects determines readiness. Granite PM Academy's advisors can verify your qualifications and highlight any gaps before you enroll.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Boot Camp delivers the PMI-mandated contact hours in an intensive format designed for working professionals. Attend sessions on your schedule, interact with experienced instructors in real time, and master the PMBOK Guide framework that anchors the exam.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing Granite PM Academy's course, formally apply to PMI with your education and experience credentials. Pay the examination fee directly to PMI. Our team guides you through the application portal and answers questions about documentation requirements so your submission is complete and error-free.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Granite PM Academy provides targeted exam-preparation resources, practice questions, and study guidance tailored to the PMP assessment format. Schedule your proctored exam through PMI's testing partner at a location convenient to you in the Fayetteville area, then sit for the credential exam.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: PMP certification requires renewal every three years by earning professional development units (PDUs) across defined knowledge domains. Granite PM Academy offers PDU-bearing workshops and resources to keep your credential current and your skills aligned with evolving project-management practices.
